name: James Uthmeier
summary: James William Uthmeier ( UHTH-my-ər; born November 25, 1987) is an American politician and attorney serving as the 39th attorney general of Florida since 2025. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as chief of staff to Governor Ron DeSantis from 2021 to 2025.
